run_logs_cli: run the click CLI command to tail logs for one or more defined processes
run_logs_old_flag: run the logs command with the --old flag to retrieve historical logs instead of live feeds
review_log_listener_creation: review how a0.LogListener is created with DBG level and INIT_OLDEST or INIT_AWAIT_NEW modes
review_autocomplete_conditional: review the conditional shell autocomplete that suggests running processes or defined processes based on the --old flag
review_signal_handling: review the SIGINT and SIGTERM signal handlers that exit cleanly when ctrl-c is pressed
